summary: 3 selected Alignment images; Six separate Lagoon alignment candidates spanning optical, near-, mid- and far-infrared. Two Hubble images cover only the central detail; the Herschel context has incomplete survey support. This packet records source facts and literature, not accepted registration or processed nebulae.

papers.title: The infrared Hourglass cluster in M8
papers.authors: J. I. Arias, R. H. Barbá, J. Maíz Apellániz, N. I. Morrell, M. Rubio
papers.access: Open author preprint; abstract and bibliographic record inspected, scientific arrays not downloaded.
constraints: Local Hourglass study: Las Campanas JHKs imaging, archival HST morphology and ESO longslit spectra; relevant to the Hubble detail footprints.
Reports a 1.25 kpc distance estimate for early-type stars and identifies jets/bow shocks/HH features. These are local results, not a measured whole-cloud volume.
Photometry and longslit evidence require original footprint, selection and uncertainty qualification before numerical reuse.

papers.title: Geysers in the Lagoon: new Herbig-Haro objects in M8
papers.authors: Rodolfo H. Barbá and Julia I. Arias
papers.access: Open author preprint; abstract and bibliographic record inspected, source images/spectra not downloaded.
constraints: La Silla wide-field H-alpha and [S II] narrowband images trace projected shock/outflow structures and five newly reported HH objects.
Useful for optical feature identification and follow-up around candidate driving stars; projected morphology alone is not a 3D flow or velocity field.
Image masks, exact fields and line calibration need inspection before treating figures as data.

papers.title: The Gaia-ESO Survey: Asymmetric expansion of the Lagoon Nebula cluster NGC 6530 from GES and Gaia DR2
papers.access: Open author preprint; abstract/bibliography inspected, stellar table not imported.
constraints: Approximately 900 selected NGC 6530 members combine Gaia proper motions with Gaia-ESO radial velocities.
Reported anisotropic expansion is strongest in declination, with little right-ascension expansion; a simple spherical expansion law is inappropriate.
Stellar kinematics do not measure the line-of-sight gas density or assign membership to every image star.

papers.title: The effects of stellar feedback on molecular clumps in the Lagoon Nebula (M8)
papers.access: Open full text inspected: observations, archival-data coverage and interpretation limits; spectra/photometry not downloaded.
constraints: 37 clump pointings: APEX 210–280 GHz and IRAM 30m 70–117 GHz; observed beams span roughly 21–35 arcseconds, with three telescope pointing pairs offset by up to 1 arcminute.
IR-to-submillimetre SEDs supplement spectroscopy. Hi-GAL incompletely covers M8; AKARI supplies missing bands at coarser beams.

Foreground infrared emission can coincide with molecular clumps without tracing them. Derived temperatures/masses depend on SED assumptions; use source-specific masks and pointings before any future model.
The paper adopts 1325 pc from prior work; this is not a new distance measurement or a depth field.

papers.title: SDSS-V LVM: A spatially resolved study of the physical conditions and the chemical abundance discrepancy in the Lagoon Nebula (M 8)
papers.access: Open full-text observations/data-reduction and map descriptions inspected. Figure-set repository identified; numerical lvmSFrame data not downloaded or qualified.
constraints: Whole-nebula optical IFS: 10 tiles, about 1.1 square degrees, 35.3-arcsecond fibre diameter at 37-arcsecond pitch. Observed 2023-08-22 through 2023-10-19, with supplemental 2024-07-02 exposures.
Line atlas includes H-alpha/H-beta, [O III], [N II], [S II], O II recombination lines, extinction, temperature and density diagnostics. The authors adopt 1.25 kpc for physical sampling.
Original row-stacked FITS provide FLUX, IVAR, MASK, WAVE and SLITMAP sky positions. Preserve dead-fibre/bright-star masks, line S/N selection and extinction correction.
The 27-map figure set is plotted evidence, not a calibrated image/WCS intake. No figure digitization or inference of line-of-sight depth is authorized here.

evidencePolicy: Native byte hashes and dimensions have been checked; WCS values were read from publisher AVM or FITS.
Angular sampling is the selected raster grid spacing, never a substitute for measured PSF/beam resolution.
Publisher astrometry is provisional. No stellar registration, star removal, reconstruction, compilation or bake was performed for this intake.
Source image differences include tracers, coverage, epoch, PSF and display stretch. They do not by themselves establish density, membership or physical depth.

selection.reason: Full-nebula optical and complementary near/mid-infrared structure with passing relative field-star checks. Hubble close-ups remain unverified; the Herschel map is zero-filled over the central Lagoon region.
